payload.rationale: Planning-stage guide (brief journey_stage 'planning'), primary persona planner_couple. Wedded Concierge is the brief's goal and the default commercial target in the link map; both /wonderland-concierge and /magazine are live in link-map.csv (last checked 2026-10-20). All three Concierge links use the anchor 'Wedded Concierge' (2 words, no exclamation mark, no 'click here'), with the surrounding sentence naming the Wedded Advisor as the person and Concierge as the service, which resolves the panel's Advisor-versus-Concierge confusion (planner_couple, sceptic, search_visitor) and search_visitor's request for one plain line saying what Concierge is. Every claim around the CTAs is from brand-facts (single point of contact, venue, travel, vendors and payments anywhere in the world, fee agreed in writing before any work begins, time zone, AUD quotes, written inclusions); nothing implies the Advisor handles legal paperwork, notice lodgement, registration or acts as celebrant. Panel cta_reactions: planner_couple, funding_parent and sceptic were 'maybe', search_visitor and uhnw 'no'; weighted enquiry likelihood 1.7, which is expected for an informational legal how-to and fits low-pressure placement. The 'what I'd want to see first' items are fee structure and commissions (sceptic) and what happens after clicking (funding_parent). Neither can be answered in this post without brand sign-off (fee model is 'deferred' in brand-facts), so no copy change is flagged here; both are routed as open questions for the /wonderland-concierge page. Lead magnet suggestion, not placed (exists: false): search_visitor asked for a printable or downloadable copy of the full script; no such asset exists on the site, so it is noted here as a future magnet idea only. The utm_medium for the magazine link is 'lead_magnet' per the orchestrator's instruction, which differs from the services.md default of 'content'; documented as placed, not changed.
